# `silk/platform/wasi/host_input`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

A snapshot of WASI command arguments and environment variables.

## When to use
Use `WasiHostInput.capture` to provide `HostInput` inside a WASI command.
The WASI runtime supplies this provider to an application that requires `HostInput`.

## Details
The snapshot owns its bytes. The working directory is `/` in the guest namespace.
The host grants filesystem access separately through preopened directories.
